note: Single source of truth. Builders import these numbers; they are NOT copy-pasted per clip. Adding a Mars correction = adding a rule here + a regression fixture, then the gate enforces it on every future build. That is the learning mechanism.

rules.industry_basis: Toon Boom Harmony Z-depth keyframing (timeline order = render order, Z-nudge per frame); Godot cutout Behind-Parent/Z keyframing; traditional cutout stacking.
rules.name: Arm-front snap (chest)
rules.threshold: forearm_vs_torso_overlap_px > 1000 at 1100x1500 => whole arm chain (upper+forearm+fist+cap) MUST be above torso, below head (torso < arm < head), per arm, per frame, momentary only. Snap with overlap <= 1000 FAILS (floating arm).

rules.industry_basis: Harmony Z-depth keyframing, hands behind head then over mouth in same scene.
rules.name: Face snap
rules.threshold: forearm_vs_head_overlap_px > 5000 => whole arm chain MUST be above head (torso < head < arm). Below that, arm over face FAILS.

rules.industry_basis: Harmony/Animate per-pose re-layering out of a parent, not a permanent rig change.
rules.name: Cowl/collar snap, upper only
rules.threshold: Cowl snap is UPPER-ONLY, candidate + eye-check only, never automatic. Whole-chain cowl snap is BANNED (JoJo 02 L proved it puts a fist over the face).

rules.industry_basis: Tibia tracks over 2nd toe (sports-therapy/gait literature); foot progression angle; knee is a hinge, valgus and varus are both misalignments.
rules.name: Knee-feet, per frame, bidirectional
rules.threshold: Knee direction == foot/toe direction on THAT frame. Inward knees => inward toes; outward knees => outward toes; straight => straight. FootIn = True ONLY if leg_upper L > 0 AND R < 0 (thigh-angle sign, not x-offset, not a block range). A block range with no per-frame table FAILS.

rules.industry_basis: Same tibia/2nd-toe basis as R04, with a Mars-authored per-leg exception recorded, not a new anatomy claim.
rules.mars_date: 2026-11-01 11:30 CST bundle note, corrected to universal 2026-11-01 12:07 CST
rules.name: Leg1 / Leg2 foot exception, 2026-11-01
rules.threshold: UNIVERSAL RULE FIRST (2026-11-01 12:07 CST correction, Mars repeated): knees direction == foot/toe direction, per frame, both legs. Knees inward => toes inward, knees outward => toes outward. Anatomy research (tibia over 2nd toe) required before any pose ships, gate FAILS knees-in/toes-out. EXCEPTION ONLY when Mars names a specific pose as an exception for that pose; the 2026-11-01 11:30 anatomy-bundle leg1-only note was for THAT bundle/clip only and does NOT carry forward as a default. Without a Mars-named specific-pose exception, do NOT leave LEG1 unturned, and never excuse LEG2.

rules.industry_basis: Harmony cut-out hierarchy (child follows parent); Blender bone parenting.
rules.name: Wrist attach, no wrist cut
rules.threshold: Open hands attach by WRIST end to forearm end, not fingertips. Gate PASS iff wrist distance <= 30 px AND wrist nearer than fingertip. Hands go WITH the wrist; never cut any part of the wrist off; a fused assembly stays fused whole; hand must not be placed separately from the forearm. Bone-parent (forearm child of arm, hand child of forearm) supersedes PIL pasting for arms/hands.

rules.industry_basis: Anatomy: a flex is elbow flexion with shoulders abducted, biceps displayed, not arms pinched together over the head; obtuse shoulder abduction reads as a flex, acute pinching reads as strain/overexertion.
rules.name: Flex, obtuse, 70-90 degrees wider
rules.threshold: At the flex moment AND the moments before it, arm motions must be about 70-90 degrees WIDER from the middle / above his head, so the flex is MORE OBTUSE. Both arms too acute reads as a super-extreme overexerted flex, not a flex. Gate: flex_spread_deg (angle between the two arm motions through the top) must be 100-160 deg. Below 100 = acute FAIL. Above 160 = over-wide, eye-check required. The old acute fixture (35 deg) FAILS; a 120 deg fixture (85 wider) PASSES.

rules.industry_basis: Anatomy: elbow is a hinge, flexion bends forearm forward relative to upper arm, elbow point trails backward; a reversed elbow reads as a broken/reversed joint.
rules.name: Elbow direction, not backwards
rules.threshold: Elbows must point backward/outward in the direction of the motion, never forward/inward reversed. Arm motion direction must match the intended motion sign (flex/raise/punch forward, not reversed). elbow_dir must be 'back' or 'out' for both arms; 'forward'/'in' FAILS. Arm motion sign reversed vs intended FAILS.

rules.industry_basis: Dance/walk-cycle step structure: weight transfer = one foot lifts, the other supports; a shuffle is alternating single-support steps, not a two-foot slide.
rules.name: Side-to-side shuffle, alternating steps, one leg lifted
rules.source_doc: This task; SQUAT SQUAT SHUFFLE OOGA BOOGA THREE QUARTER TURN AND THEN FORWARD FACE
rules.threshold: When he shuffles side to side, he must pick ONE leg up and then step, alternating L,R,L,R. Steps must alternate, never the same leg twice in a row, never both legs together as a step (holds excepted), and every step must have a lifted leg (lifted_leg != null) with the other foot planted. No-lift, same-leg-repeat, or slide-without-lift FAILS.

rules.industry_basis: Animation grounding / contact poses in walk and dance cycles.
rules.name: Grounded
rules.threshold: Feet planted unless the shot is labelled airborne. If airborne=false, foot ground-y must stay within 5 px of the ground line for planted feet; a floating foot FAILS.

rules.industry_basis: Cut-out cape rigging: collar parented to torso, hanging cape pinned/draped, not a single flat sheet.
rules.name: Cape two parts
rules.threshold: Cape = collar (shoulder/top) + back/hanging part, separate layers. Collar/top MUST move with shoulders/torso (collar_dy == torso_dy); seated bottom is pinned (bottom_dy == 0, sitting on it). A single fused cape, or a collar that does not move with the torso, FAILS where cape fields are present.

rules.industry_basis: Clean-cut pipeline (slice_clean.py only); rembg is NOT a conversion method.
rules.name: No crop, no hand-draw, no square crop
rules.threshold: Never square/rectangularly cut a piece. Piece swaps = remove/omit the piece LAYER, never erase pixels. cropped, square_crop, or hand_drawn true FAILS.

rules.industry_basis: WCAG 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold; Harding/PEAT photosensitive-epilepsy testing (proxy only, not a clinical certification).
rules.name: Flicker / seizure safety, whole-frame
rules.threshold: WCAG 2.3.1 proxy: no more than 3 opposing luminance pairs >= 25.5 (10% of 255) in any 1 second, darker < 204, and no red flash > 0.01 fraction reversing in 1 second. Exceeding FAILS. NOTE: the dance-test forearm-box metric is layout-specific and must NOT be reused on a different layout without re-tuning its boxes; this gate uses whole-frame only for video mode, and reports that limit.
